description:
**CVRP polar petal generation and set partitioning.** Use planar coordinates, a depot, nonnegative demands and at most 12 customers. Sort customers by polar angle.

Generate every capacity-feasible consecutive cyclic segment starting at each angle-ordered customer. Route a segment of at most eight customers exactly and retain angular order for larger segments. These candidate petals form the input to a restricted disjoint cover.

The set-partitioning step selects combinations among overlapping candidate petals rather than committing to the first greedy angle cut. Optimality pertains to the restricted route family.
